tc_text: By using Crisis Reporter you agree to submit accurate damage reports and allow UNDP to use your submitted data for crisis response coordination. Your location and photos will be stored securely. This platform is operated by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). Data collected will be used solely for humanitarian response purposes and will not be shared with third parties without your consent except as required by law.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.contact_prompt: Can't find what you're looking for?
faq.q1_question: How do I submit a report?
faq.q1_answer: Tap "Report an Incident" on the Home screen. You will be guided through steps — take or upload a photo, confirm your location, answer damage assessment questions, then review and submit. At least one photo is required.
faq.q2_question: Do I need an internet connection to submit a report?
faq.q2_answer: No. If you are offline your report will be saved to a queue on your device and sent automatically when internet returns. You can see queued reports in My Reports.
faq.q3_question: How do I enable GPS on my device?
faq.q3_answer: On most devices go to Settings, then Location or Privacy, and enable Location Services. In your browser you may need to allow location access when prompted. GPS helps us pinpoint the exact building affected.
faq.q4_question: Can I submit a report anonymously?
faq.q4_answer: Yes. You do not need to create an account or fill in any profile details to submit a report. Adding your email or phone number is optional and links your reports to your profile.
faq.q5_question: What happens to my report after I submit it?
faq.q5_answer: Your report is received by UNDP staff who review it for accuracy. Verified reports are used to coordinate crisis response and damage assessment. Your identity is never shared publicly.
faq.q6_question: How do I earn a Safety Training badge?
faq.q6_answer: Complete all parts of Safety Tips — Part A covers all 9 disaster types, Part B covers reporting guidelines, Part C covers first aid. Then add an email or phone number to your profile. The badge is awarded automatically.
faq.q7_question: What if my country is not in the list?
faq.q7_answer: Crisis Reporter is currently operational in countries where UNDP is actively responding to a crisis. If your country is not listed it means UNDP has not yet activated it. Check back during an active crisis event.
faq.q8_answer: Email us at {{email}} — we will respond within 48 hours.
faq.q9_question: Can I edit or delete a report after submitting?
faq.q9_answer: Reports cannot be edited after submission. If you submitted a report in error please contact support with the date and location of the report.
faq.q10_answer: Yes. All data is transmitted over encrypted connections and stored securely. Photos are anonymised before storage. Your personal details are never shared with third parties.

about.title: About Crisis Reporter
about.mission: Crisis Reporter is a UNDP initiative that enables community members to document and report damage to buildings and infrastructure following disasters and crises. Your contributions help humanitarian teams deploy resources where they are needed most.
about.legal: This application is operated by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). Data submitted through this platform is used solely for humanitarian response coordination and is handled in accordance with UNDP's data privacy policies.
